description: This file defines a class 'CommonCodecTypeFilter' that provides a static method to determine if a given type is either an abstract type or a framework-specific type, based on certain attributes and properties.

classes.name: CommonCodecTypeFilter
classes.description: Provides static methods for filtering types based on framework or abstract status.

methods.name: IsAbstractOrFrameworkType
methods.description: Checks if a given type is either abstract, marked with the 'GeneratedCode' attribute with tool 'OrleansCodeGen', or part of a framework assembly.
